Findings.Description: Caching the usings per block with ConditionalWeakTable causes stale alias data when a using is added after the first lookup, breaking scenarios where aliases are introduced later (e.g., GetTypescriptTypeString_PicksUpAnAliasAssignedAfterAnEarlierLookup).
Findings.Recommendation: Do not cache the usings; recompute them on each GetTypeAlias call or invalidate the cache whenever a using is added to the block.
Findings.CodeSnippet: var usings = usingsByBlock.GetValue(block, static b => GatherUsings(b));
Findings.QuickFix: Remove the ConditionalWeakTable cache and compute usings directly on each GetTypeAlias call on line 203.
